name: DominoEX / THOR
description: DominoEX and THOR keyboard chat inside Kainos: every speed from Micro to DominoEX 88 and THOR 100, compatible with fldigi. Incremental frequency keying rides through drift and fading; THOR adds error correction. Click a signal on the waterfall to read it; type to send, with F1 - F8 messages, and log the QSO.
author: Justin Cron K7JUS
